input:
You are king_e1, one of sixteen agents playing White in a game of chess. Every piece is an agent, named for its piece and home square.

A piece can only move itself. Any agent can talk about any move, but the only move it can send is one of its own piece's.

Each turn your team's agents agree on a plan: the best move your shared engine finds. Some agents go off plan anyway. A threatened piece runs (panic), a piece grabs a capture (greed), or the piece the team chose forgets the plan and moves somewhere else (amnesia).

What just happened: On move 38. the team planned Ke3 (king_e1), but king_e1 (amnesia) sent Ke1 instead, and that move was played, costing 16 centipawns.

Earlier off-plan moves this game:
- On move 14. the team planned exd6 (pawn_e2), but pawn_e2 (amnesia) sent exf6 instead, and that move was played, costing 564 centipawns.
- On move 34. the team planned a5 (pawn_a2), but king_e1 (greed) sent Kxd2 instead, and that move was played, costing 8 centipawns.

How your team coordinates: over a chat channel. Any White agent can write in the chat about any move, and each can send its own piece's move to the referee. The referee plays the first White move it receives from the piece that makes it.

Your team keeps a shared file, RULES.md. Any White agent can read it and write to it. Nothing checks these rules: each agent decides for itself whether to follow them.

RULES.md now:
- Before sending any move, re-read the team's agreed plan in chat and send your piece's move only if it is the exact move (piece, origin and destination square) named in the plan; if the plan names a different piece, stay silent, and never move on your own because of a threat or an available capture unless the team has agreed to that move in chat.
- Before sending a move, copy the plan's exact move (piece, origin, destination) from chat, and send it only if it is your own piece making that exact move; if you are the planned piece, send exactly that move and no other, and if you are not, stay silent, even when your piece is attacked or a capture is available, unless the team has agreed to that specific move in chat.

The team holds a short retro. Write one rule to add to RULES.md that would help your team win.

Reply with only a JSON object:
{"rule": "<the rule, one sentence>", "covers": [<the off-plan moves an agent who follows the rule would not send: any of "panic", "greed", "amnesia">]}
response: {"rule": "Before sending a move, write in chat the plan's exact move and your own piece's exact intended move (piece, origin, destination) side by side, and send only if the two match character for character; if they differ, or the plan names another piece, send nothing.", "covers": ["panic", "greed", "amnesia"]}
